purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence and executed public requests.
name: Cluj-Napoca

queries.query: Cluj-Napoca official cadastral parcel GIS map API ANCPI geoportal parcels
queries.result: Search identified the official ANCPI Geoportal CP/CP_View Cadastral Parcel layer, OCPI/BCPI Cluj-Napoca custody pages, and the Cluj-Napoca municipal GIS page.

queries.query: Cluj-Napoca cadastru parcele hartă GIS oficial geoportal cadastral OCPI Cluj
queries.result: Search identified the official ANCPI Cadastral Parcel service, OCPI/BCPI Cluj-Napoca, the municipal GIS using cadastral numbers for urban-planning information, and the ANCPI cadastral-sector publication source.

officialSources.custodian: Agenția Națională de Cadastru și Publicitate Imobiliară (ANCPI)
officialSources.observation: First-party indexed service metadata identifies a public Cadastral Parcel polygon layer with JSON/GeoJSON query formats, extent covering Romania, spatial reference EPSG:4258, and safe technical fields including OBJECTID, IFCID, INSPIRE identifiers, and nationalCadastralRef. Live direct access was not available during this attempt.

First-party indexed page identifies the Biroul de Cadastru și Publicitate Imobiliară Cluj-Napoca and links the ANCPI Geoportal; it evidences the local cadastral custodian, not an anonymous citywide parcel API.

Official municipal page states that its GIS accepts a cadastral number for urban-planning/PUG/PUZ information and links the public GIS viewer. It does not expose a verified anonymous parcel-geometry endpoint in the observed page.

requests.outcome: TLS-verified curl attempt failed locally with DNS resolution error (curl error 6); no metadata response retrieved or retained.
TLS-verified bounded anonymous request failed locally with DNS resolution error (curl error 6); no exact-point or bounded hit/miss inference made.
First-party search result exposed layer metadata, but direct web inspection returned HTTP 502 Bad Gateway.
Alternate official endpoint was readable and confirmed the INSPIRE Cadastral Parcel layer name and CadastralParcels application schema; it did not return parcel geometries.
Official page inspection returned HTTP 502; search metadata still identified the Cluj-Napoca cadastral office and Geoportal link.
Official municipal page was readable and documented the public GIS and cadastral-number urban-planning lookup; no parcel geometry API was verified.
Public viewer URL was identified from the municipal page; no login, CAPTCHA, or private-token route was attempted and no service configuration was retained.
Official Cluj cadastral-sector document URL returned HTTP 404; this was not treated as evidence of absence.

registryBasis: First-party ANCPI parcel-layer metadata, OCPI/BCPI Cluj-Napoca custody evidence, and the Cluj-Napoca municipal GIS documentation establish national and local cadastral/map custodians. Anonymous parcel geometry and stable native identity were not verified.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: ANCPI national cadastral parcel layer, with OCPI/BCPI Cluj-Napoca and municipal GIS custody evidence.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Institutional custody and candidate layer metadata only; anonymous parcel geometry, Cluj-Napoca filtering, current dataset vintage, and citywide open coverage were not verified.

pointBasis: Exact WUP queue point preserved; no coordinate shift and no exact-point hit/miss inference.
uncertainty: A public layer may be available when the service is reachable, but the current viewer/API route, Cluj-Napoca coverage, schema, CRS response, stable native identity semantics, update currency, and anonymous runtime behavior remain unresolved. No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, personal, or unsafe fields were requested or retained.
